g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
l. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names ar
e unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server'
s revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest
first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or
a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…
\n- [Get one server revision](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-server-revision.md): One stored revision: ever
y tool's definition and the server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values ar
e unknown, not absent.\n- [Diff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md):
Compares `from` (default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools chang
ed with the fields that moved and both definitions, and each changed server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing be
fore it, so diffing it needs `from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-s
erver.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included: `hasClientSecret` reports presence
only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/de
lete-a-saved-server.md): Soft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted se
cret objects, and a rotation of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNCHRONOUS, so a read immediately after thi
s call may still observe the row. The request body must be empty.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/servers/update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409
` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are m
utually exclusive.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-server-g
roups.md): A server group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run of
f its host's live server list, so a composed run keeps testing the servers it was composed against even after the shared host is e
dited.\n- [Snapshot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-server
-group.md): Creates a server group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only: t
here is no update route, because an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique pe
r project, so a clash responds `409`. Servers must b…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/env
ironments/list-a-projects-environments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unle
ss `includeArchived=true`: you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environment-surface-supports.md): Report which enviro
nment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model override: clients ship independently of the platform
, and a field an older deployment does not know is a hard validation error there rather than a silently ignored one. A deployment
too old to answer rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/show-one-environment.md): Read
one environment, including the `revision` you pass back as `expectedRevision` when writing to it.\n- [Preview what an environment
resolves to](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/preview-what-an-environment-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environme
nt to the exact execution inputs a run would use right now: the host's current config and the closed server set. Returns 409 when
the environment cannot currently produce a runnable configuration; `details.code` carries the specific reason (`ENV_NO_SERVERS`, `
ENV_HOST_MISSING`, ……\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a composed stack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environ
ments/get-or-create-an-unnamed-environment-for-a-composed-stack.md): GET-OR-CREATE an UNNAMED, content-addressed environment for a
composed stack: a host plus an optional server group and model override. The environment does not appear in the project's list of
named environments.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): Ar
chive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored
: this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision`: the revision you last read. If the enviro
nment changed since, the write is reje…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-proje
cts-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project: name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Pu
blish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md):
PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment return
s the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Unpublishing does not require User Testing access, s
o an organization that loses access can still take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studi
es/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share
link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure, but not both in one call. **
Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the st
udy live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scena
rios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only: this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowli
st, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored
blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-executio
n-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT. Send every field. These caps only mean something as a set,
and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share li
nk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from gra
nting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/in
vite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [R
emove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVers
ion` and cuts off any session that member already had: it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a di
fferent environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the stud
